payload.rationale: User selection on 2026-09-09: use WSL when Projector runs natively on Windows, and preserve direct WSL operation. The local evaluation used Windows 25H2 build 26200.9168, Ubuntu WSL, bubblewrap 0.9.0 and bundled Node 24.20.0. Live probes exercised the declared isolation contract and immutable overlays; this supports the bounded backend choice, not a universal sandbox security claim. Native alternatives were evaluated rather than assumed impossible. Reasons and testable conditions are retained here so a later agent can reconsider the choice without repeating the investigation. Investigation provenance: .temp/windows-sandbox-investigation.md; executable evidence: packages/runtime/src/execution/wsl-sandbox-launcher.test.ts and sandbox-launcher.test.ts, with installed acceptance captured locally. Revisit when a published native package demonstrates the whole contract, safe cleanup and frozen validation without an unreviewed dependency fork, or when WSL support no longer meets project constraints.
